**Chinese name:** 乐鑫信息科技（上海）股份有限公司 (Yuèxīn Kējì)

::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
The only Chinese fabless with genuine global developer-ecosystem dominance (Wi-Fi MCU #1 worldwide) — FY2025 revenue ¥25.65亿 (+27.8%), net ¥4.98亿, overseas revenue +40.4%; H1 2026 ¥14.81亿 (+18.9%). Its pivot to fully self-developed RISC-V cores removes the last foreign-IP dependency across its mainstream line.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Wi-Fi/BLE/Thread connectivity SoCs and MCUs with self-designed RISC-V CPUs, plus modules/devkits (M5Stack majority-owned).

## Key Facts

| | |
|---|---|
| **Category** | Fabless |
| **Founded** | 2008 |
| **Location** | Shanghai, Shanghai Municipality |
| **Product Focus** | Wi-Fi/Bluetooth/802.15.4 connectivity SoCs — the ESP32 family (C/H/P/S lines) from entry MCU to dual-band Wi-Fi 6 (ESP32-C5) and BLE 6.0 (ESP32-H4) |
| **Node Sophistication** | 40nm-class mainstream — deliberately mature; value is in integration and software, not geometry |
| **Entity List** | No |
